rootCauses.title: Midlife route and identity collapse across persona pairs
rootCauses.summary: 1 near-duplicate pairs share action distribution and/or summary identity despite different early strategies. First-wave fix: diverge midlife route events for wealth/travel and cautious/deviant pairs.

rootCauses.title: Visible progression exists but gate token matcher misses it
rootCauses.summary: 2 personas have route/identity/stat progression without hard token matches. Extend causality detector to route state and summary references.

rootCauses.title: Replay similarity scoring driven by shared midlife event pool
rootCauses.summary: Multiple personas converge on the same turning-point events (e.g. martial tournament). Route definitions should declare persona-specific divergence points.
